title: Temporal target tracking and smoothing
purpose: Maintain a short-lived, smoothed target track across frames so a single missed frame does not falsely signal target loss.
architecturalScope: VisualSearch bounded context. Sits between TargetProductDetector and Guidance; owns track state, not detection.
domainContext: TargetTrack, ProductCandidate, Confidence, RelativePosition, Timestamp. Emits candidate/tracked/lost as domain facts.

milestones.title: Bounded smoothing
milestones.description: A short miss window keeps the track alive; only sustained misses declare loss.

tasks.title: Implement smoothing and lost-detection
acceptanceCriteria: Single missed frame does not produce TARGET_LOST in tests.
Tracking is deterministic and unit-testable from frame sequences.
Confidence is smoothed and never inflated.

risks.description: Smoothing too aggressive delays useful feedback.

safetyImplications: Smoothing must not keep asserting a target that is gone beyond the miss window.
accessibilityImplications: Track state changes drive spoken updates; hysteresis reduces confusing chatter.
privacyImplications: Track state is ephemeral and discarded after the session.
verificationRequirements: Sequence-based unit tests including temporary misses.
